title: Claims lack primary sources
observation: 19 of 28 extracted claims circulate in secondary or aggregator coverage without a primary source behind them
cost: An investor will see a large share of unverified statements and may doubt the credibility of the founder’s track record. This uncertainty can delay funding decisions or lower valuation.
fix: Publish the original source for each claim on the company website and link it in press releases.

title: Long silence between updates
observation: across 8 datable public artifacts the longest silence was 26 months, between 2021-05-28 and 2023-08-05
cost: A prospective LP will notice the 4 month gap since the most recent artifact and may question ongoing activity. The 5 gaps over three months further suggest irregular communication.
fix: Release a brief update this week summarizing recent activities and schedule the next public artifact within the next month.

title: Third-party narrative dominates
observation: 16 of 19 public sources are written by third parties, against 3 the subject controls
cost: A journalist will find the founder’s voice rarely present, which can make the story feel second-hand and reduce perceived authority. An investor may view the lack of self-authored content as a missed opportunity to shape the narrative.
fix: Write and publish one new article under Khaled’s byline this week and update the author page to reflect the current affiliation.
